SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS open_tasks
FROM tasks
WHERE status = 'open'
  AND deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY project_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY open_tasks DESC, project_id;
